model_annotation: The bar chart compares the performance of six different language models—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across multiple evaluation categories, which are represented along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis measures performance, likely in terms of accuracy or F1 score, with values ranging from approximately 0 to 1.0, marked with regular tick intervals (e.g., 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each category on the x-axis contains a grouped set of six bars, each corresponding to one model, color-coded as per the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light red for mBERT-B₂, and dark red for XLM-B₂. Error bars are present on top of each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The bars vary significantly in height across categories, with some categories showing high performance (e.g., near 0.9 or above) for certain models, while others show very low performance (near 0.0). In several categories, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ achieve the highest scores, often above 0.8, while in others, mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ show strong performance. The bars are arranged in the same order for each group, and there is no explicit sorting of categories along the x-axis. No specific category labels are visible on the x-axis, and no annotations or highlights are applied to any particular bar.
